batting.name: JH Kallis
batting.dismissal: c LRPL Taylor b Mohammed Shami

batting.name: G Gambhir
batting.dismissal: c JP Duminy b NM Coulter-Nile

batting.name: RV Uthappa
batting.dismissal: c LRPL Taylor b JD Unadkat

batting.name: MA Agarwal
batting.dismissal: c PP Chawla b M Morkel

batting.name: MK Tiwary
batting.dismissal: c SP Narine b M Morkel

batting.name: JDS Neesham
batting.dismissal: c YK Pathan b PP Chawla

balls.text: one more extra delivery, and this goes for four too, Yadav bends, and reverses the full toss over short third man once more, seems to play this shot remarkably well, keeps eyes on the ball and twists his wrists very late

that extra ball because of that wide might still cost them, this is a very high full toss, and Yadav has sent it screaming over short third man with a neat reverse paddle even as he swivels away to avoid getting hit
he tries some kind of a reverse scoop, but this is shortish and bounces past
Coulter Nile keeps bowling yorkers, this is outside off now, Yusuf gets down on his knee and swings, and inside-edges it into his stumps
and one more in the blockhole, terrific execution from Couter Nile, Shakib can only squeeze it to the off side
top stuff from the bowler, first he pings it into the blockhole, Shakib knocks it to his left, and Coulter Nile goes flying like a goalkeeper to pouch it
full toss hit to long on
it is called a wide, Yusuf has almost been hit by this short ball down leg, it has gone over his shoulder as he misses, Coulter Nile asks it it was called for height, DK can't believe it
in the blockhole, dug out into the pitch and over the bowler, Shakib is running back for the second, but Yusuf sends him back, no way Yusuf was making it back in time
138.8 kph full delivery on middle and leg swung along the ground to wide long on
a slower length ball turned in front of square leg
cannot get under this full ball around off, but they will benefit from the mistiming to steal two at vacant midwicket
cracks a full ball straight down the ground, long on slides and saves it, but they have taken only one
Shakib's tried the lap and pulled it off, he's walked outside off, the length ball arrives there, and he turns it very fine down the leg side
has a heave at a pitched up ball, which travels high and falls at vacant mid on
poor line to the left-hander, good length down the pads, and Shakib swipes it to the deep backward square boundary
top edges a 141 kph short ball, and it falls quite short of the man running in from deep midwicket
short and climbing on Shakib, who awkwardly pulls it down to fine leg
moves across, it is full around off, and he can only hit it along the ground to long on
and finds the boundary first ball, whips a full ball angled in, beats midwicket's jump, and also JP D's sliding attempt in the deep
Uthappa finds deep midwicket this time, it was shortish, angled in, right in the pulling zone, he swung it from outside the crease, and into the safe hands of Ross Taylor
cannot get under this full delivery and squeezes it out to the off side instead
comes down the track and hits it hard on the bounce to long off
neatly done, very full outside off, not too much width, but Uthappa opens the face and times it to deep backward point rope
makes some room but cannot get much power on the loft through the off side as he falls away a tad
pushes a length ball to the off side and gets the single that takes him to 50
skips out, takes it on the full, and finds long off
full on middle and leg, he squeezes it out to the sweeper
around the blockhole and squeezed out to the off side
Uthappa running away now, he's swung another boundary to deep square leg, reached forward and mowed it in the air
down the pads, swept hard, and well wide of short fine leg
well adjusted, he did not have the length or the angle to swing leg side, so he waits and chips it over the bowler
walks far across but fails to get bat on this delivery that goes past leg stump
full toss on middle, Shakib turns it straight to square leg, there is a direct hit here, but Shakib has made it back in time, he was slow in turning around
full delivery now eased down the ground
Uthappa in flow, on the leg side now, this is shortish, Uthappa swings it off the front foot and times it to the deep square leg rope
lashed over wide long off, Uthappa gets a length ball, steps forward, bends a knee and hammers it high
charges out to a slow and wide one, edges it high in the air, it rolls down to third man
nudged square on the leg side
Shakib leaves the crease again, and goes inside out over extra cover, Agarwal in business again with a run from long off, dives and parries it away from the rope
full one crashed down straight to long off
he's charged out but mishit this lofted stroke, Agarwal comes forward at long on, he dives in front, but it bounces ahead of him, nice effort
makes room outside leg, this one is on middle and staying a bit low, he toe-ends it to the bowler
bowls it flat around off, Shakib tries to dab it away, but cannot get much purchase on it
comes out again, Nadeem pings it full into the pad, Shakib adjusts to nudge it square
Shakib down the track, gets under the ball and wallops it high over deep midwicket
stayed a bit low this time, as Uthappa went back to punch it, squirts it behind square leg

oh dear me, meltdowns galore, Uthappa wants a single after pushing to the leg side, non-striker is not interested, Uthappa is half way down when he turns, he should have no chance, but he will instead get bonus runs, as Nadeem's throw is nowhere near the keeper, forget the stumps
tossed up slower, he comes forward and runs it to point, not getting anything for that
punched through midwicket
neat, Uthappa reverse sweeps a tossed up ball from around off, and beats short third man with a crisp connection
turned off the pad behind square leg
punched off the back foot on the off side
pushes forward for some turn from the offspinner, but there is not much, and it is a bit of a leading edge down the track
got him this time, slows it down a bit, gives it some air, the line is around off, Pandey is confused immediately, pushes weakly for some turn, there isn't any, and the stumps are rattled
much cleaner this time, Nadeem continues to push it towards leg stump, and Pandey carts it in front of square leg once more
sees him coming out, pushes it quick into the pad, Pandey swings in front of square and beats the man in the deep
that turned quite a bit, it was angled sharply into the pad initially and straightened on Uthappa, who defended and accepted the single as it rolled square on the off side
down the track to nudge it through midwicket
Pandey moves a tad towards the leg side and crashes this pitched up ball through extra cover, long off gets to it
a slower one to end the over and Pandey has to check his shot to extra cover as he charges out
goes hard at a full delivery but it does not have enough in it to split long on and long off
worked off the pad to the leg side for a single
dances down and goes through with an elegant attempted loft down the ground, but misses the ball
moves across outside off and tries to slog it, but it is too full, and he mishits it to deep midwicket, had Neesham's throw hit, Uthappa was gone by miles

now he bowls a conventional left-armer's away spinning ball, it is defended towards cover, non-striker wants non-existent singles, but escapes as the throw is weak, and bowler is standing too far behind the stumps expecting a stronger one
another one pushed into middle and leg, and turned to deep midwicket
shortish and angled in, worked in front of square on leg
tosses it up a tad, he comes down the track, but is not to the pitch and pushes it past the non-striker softly
flatter one pitched shortish and comes in to the right-hander, is punched to the sweeper
bowled in to the pad with the angle, he walks across, goes back and punches it through midwicket for two
turns a good length ball off the pad to the leg side for one
much more intent on this pull from Pandey, straight to deep midwicket though

dropped, Uthappa checks a pull and hits it high to Taylor at short midwicket, he gets both hands to the ball as it comes over his head, parries it over, but falls to the ground and even as he stretches, the ball falls well out of his reach
keeps walking out, this one is short now, and he turns it wristily to deep midwicket
comes forward and opens the face to pick up an easy single to cover-point region
comes down the crease, Unadkat slows it down, at 114 kph, and batsman stops and adjusts to knock it to the off side
better from Neesham to end, with a good length ball outside off, that is pushed to mid off for one
walks across again and Neesham cracks now by sending it down the leg side
this has been cracked through extra cover, Pandey walks across to a full and wide one, and clobbers it
opens the face and guides a back of a length ball to third man
comes down the track, but is cramped for room by a shortish one, knocks it past the non-striker for one
flying stop by Manoj Tiwary at point, as Pandey guides this slowish length ball to his right
short again, but in Pandey's range this time, and he slams a pull in the air, to the deep midwicket boundary
Neesham starts with one so wide it was wide in any format you can think of
turns it towards midwicket for a single
pushed to mid off
not happening for Pandey at the moment, he tries to make some room and manufacture a cut, but is beaten by some extra bounce
pushes on the off side and runs, had JP D picked up this one cleanly at cover, they were struggling to avoid the run out, what with hesitation in going for the run
ending inches outside off stump after being pushed across on a length, he adjusts to guide it to third man
Unadkat starts with a 126 kph short ball on the pads, and is fortunate the batsman mishits it, couple of bounces, to deep square leg
short once more, but this one is also angled, and Pandey is cramped for room this time, plays it back
shortish from Shami, and Pandey is ready to try another pull, does not get hold of it this time but will pick up two through midwicket
Pandey connects for some returns finally, Shami digs in the short offcutter, and Pandey is waiting to pull it hard to the deep midwicket rope, first boundary of the innings
softly drops a back of a length ball close to the crease and goes through for a comfortable single
back of a length, coming in with the angle, worked to midwicket who makes a sliding stop to keep them to one
moves across to this length ball outside off and square drives towards third man
keeps strike with a pushed single towards mid off
pushed away on the off side
beaten on the pull now, it is a slower bouncer at 122 kph, and Pandey plays too early
too good for him again as he fails to get bat on this away going length ball
143.3 kph length ball just outside off, and Pandey plays a nothing shot, opening the face and ultimately pushing well inside the line
he walks across the stumps, but Shami gets one more to nip in and hurry on into the pads, too high, though
short and wide, he mishits the cut down to third man
nice, this one is pitched full just outside off, and Pandey, to his credit, does not go hard at it in desperation, he eases it into the gap at extra cover
dug in short and wide outside off, he looks to hit it but pulls out in the end
Pandey is looking clueless at the moment against this quick burst from Delhi, another one comes in, cramps him for room and he does not help himself by hopping and getting into a tangle
now this one comes in a long way after pitching, thick inside edge on to pad flap as Pandey hops again
thought about a pull as he saw it pitching short, but it swerved away too much and he let it go in the end
pitched up for the drive outside off, left alone
beaten, as he follows this length ball which bounces and moves away sharply
holds the line and zips through past the right-hander from a good length outside off, batsman pulls his bat inside the line late

and the plan has worked to perfection, successive ducks for Gautam Gambhir, he gets a back of a length ball down the pad, around hip height, tucks it fine instinctively, and there is a leg slip waiting to accept the gift
going across him, played out towards point
this back of a length ball is angled in, tucking him up, he squeezes it to the on side and setts off, direct hit was needed

Coulter-Nile produces a beauty first up, bangs it in shortish, angles it in, then gets it to move away just outside off, Pandey is off balance, he is jumping, and even as he tries to leave it half-heartedly, it pings the bat, but falls short of Taylor at slip
the over ends finally, angles this across Gambhir on a good length, and the Kolkata captain lifts his bat to let it pass
Shami alternating between rippers and wides, sends it down the left-hander's leg side now
super, Gambhir beaten first up, this pitches short of a length around middle and leg and moves away as the batsman tentatively pushes at it
this zooms in to the right-hander and nips him on the pad, but was going down easily, took him by surprise alright
nicely done, he walks out again, take this a bit high on the bat but goes through with the shot, timing it past point, third man is around, though
and he reverts to the line just outside off, this one goes straightish, and Pandey comes out of his crease and lets it be
but those two will only watch as Shami sprays this way down the leg side and even a dive from DK is futile

terrific delivery, what a start for Delhi, Shami leaps as this one kicks from just back of a length around off, straightens on Kallis, he has to play at this, prods, and the thick edge flies low to Taylor at widish slip
starts with a back of a length ball that slips down the leg side
JP D you beauty, he needs one ball of the four left to finish it, he swings a quick delivery way over the deep backward square leg boundary, that is into the upper tier
this is not over yet, Neesham advances out to a flat one and lifts it straight into the hands of deep midwicket, they cross, and JP D is on strike
a tossed up wrong 'un outside off, and Neesham is beaten
six needed off the last over as Narine beats JP D outside off on the sweep
Neesham jumps out, it is on the pad and nudged fine, even as slip races after it, they take three
tries a reverse sweep, it hits the pad and pops up on the leg side
Neesham trusts the slog sweep and gets to the other end
now this one straightens, and almost hits the off stump, missed by inches, Neesham had no idea again
no clue about this one as it rips across him to beat a waft
he tries to go over short fine leg again, but hits this full delivery straight over the keeper instead, Kallis runs around from third man to stop it
coming apart for Kolkata now, a full toss outside off, JP D walks across and laps it miles over short fine leg, and over the rope too
that's been swiped over deep square leg for six, 138 kph short of a length, just above waist height for the little man, and he attacks it eagerly, as if he was waiting for the length
Morne hands them an extra run with a bouncer down the leg side
JP D finds the boundary this time, clears front leg and lofts this length delivery cleanly over mid off
Duminy loses his bat as he reaches out to dab this yorker wide of third man, where old man Kallis throws himself to the ground to save the boundary
wants to slog this over midwicket but fails to connect to the length ball just outside off
he fires the next one in flat at 111.7 kph, it moves away from the left-hander and beats him
Neesham gets one away, jumps out, reaches this widish one and smashes it high over long off
tries to go across and pull but cannot get much bat on it, it runs behind square
goes back to a length ball and works it behind square leg
a tossed up full ball pushed to extra cover again
goes back to a pitched up ball and pushes it to extra cover
Delhi lose one more, Tiwary slashes this short of a length ball in the air and straight to Narine at third man

he makes plenty of room outside leg, Morne follows him every inch of the way, and hits him with a short of a length ball, it pops up towards point, there is a chance for a run out, but the throw misses
tries to dab this length ball to third man but it kicks sharply and beats him
short and wide slower one, he mistimes a cut to the sweeper
makes room and tries to go over extra cover, toe-ends it over the infield for a couple
opens the face to this one climbing around off, finds backward point
takes a step across and lets this go with the angle, he is expecting a wide call, but is not getting one
outside edge, there is no slip, and these are four fortunate runs, came forward to defend, but this was the one that turns the other way
that's gone, Narine with the breakthrough, DK tries a reverse paddle, misses this big offspinner and is caught in front
bowled full at the stumps and blocked back calmly
tries the reverse sweep, not much on it, but enough for a single wide of short third man
squeezed into the off side for a single, could have been tight
that is right through Morne, it's hit hard down to him at long off, couple of bounces, Morne bends and cups his wrists to stop the ball, but it goes through
down the track and eases it to long on
what a shot, DK's walked out, and his momentum has given this lofted push so much distance, it's almost gone over the deep extra cover rope, it is in the gap anyway and he reaches his 50
bowls it full and wide, Duminy is eyeing the leg side but he has to hit it down to long off
misfield by Vinay at short third man, DK opened the face and guided this fine, but it should have been stopped really
taken from well outside off and worked to deep square leg
worked in front of square leg and they will come back for the second
turns in towards the pads and is worked to short fine leg
swept to deep square leg
beaten on the cut, this was fullish outside off
pushed to mid off for one
scooped fine over the keeper, JP comes across, bends and gets enough bat on this length ball
nudged square on the leg side
tapped behind point for a quick single
widish one cut to the sweeper
that looked dead straight, but umpire Kulkarni spots the inside edge and remains unmoved
tapped to backward point
takes this from outside off and manages a top edge on the slog sweep, it weakly loops and falls in front of deep midwicket
stays a touch low, JP misses the cut, and keeper the take
shortish outside off stump, he cuts it in the air, in the gap at cover and down to the sweeper
spins away from the left-hander and is cut to backward point for one
a top edge loops towards short third man as he tries a reverse paddle
now the cut, width provided, and DK capitalises with a sharp cut
shortish, DK bends, gets under it and hits it high in the air, clears the deep square leg boundary
punches this one sliding across him to extra cover, DK had backed up too much and would have been gone in case of a direct hit
goes across the let-hander this wrong one, and JP misses the sweep, had his foot grounded even as the keeper took the bails off
quite short, but there is some turn, and DK cannot get hold of the pull
offcutter runs off the inner part of the bat to long on as DK looks to drive
punches a good length ball to extra cover, he has a go at the non-striker's, and misses
eases a pitched up ball down to long on
short of a length ball guided to third man
hit on the thigh pad as he misses a back of a length ball
goes after a widish one, but under edges it on the bounce to the keeper
whips a full tossed up ball to deep midwicket
hurls this full and straight down the leg side to the left-hander
diving stop from Yadav at short extra cover saves some runs
opens up and works this through midwicket
skips out to this tossed up ball and eases it to long on
thumped down to long on

right through him, Kallis nips this in a mile from just outside off, on a good length, Taylor has moved across and set himself up for a forcing stroke, and there is no way he can account for so much movement, through the gate and into the stumps
plays a similar shot, hits it along the ground and straight to Morne this time
Dk's swiped this with a massive top edge off his pad, tall Morne is there at fine leg, but this is too big a task for him as well
goes back to a good length, defends it late, down the track
leans into a push but it goes off the inner part of the blade for midwicket to make a diving stop
Kallis goes for four first ball, length ball angled in to the pad, and DK tucks it very fine
had the width on this shorter one but slapped it straight to cover
bowled slowly again, he pushes it to  backward point, sets off, but there is no single there, and he gets back just in time
waits on this one outside off and decides to cut quite late, hits it to backward point
Taylor with the slog sweep, an almighty top edge of a slog sweep, no one at deep square leg, and it plonks down near the rope and rolls into it
turned off the pad to deep midwicket
taps a tossed up ball to the off side for a single
turns another length ball in front of mid on for one
squeezes a good length ball to covers
punches this good length ball to the bowler who parries it behind him
leaves the crease once more, turns a length ball to wide mid on and is taking it easy on the single before he realises he has to hurry, makes it, throw misses anyway
walks out to a good length ball, is too close to it, and can only knock it to point
rides the bounce on this back of a length ball and guides it past point
not happening this time, Morne cranks it up to 147 kph on this short ball, Agarwal turns on one leg, trying to lift it over square leg, but he is not so lucky this time, loops straight to the man
he is hurried into an awkward attempt at a pull with this 140 kph short ball, but just manages to clear square leg
short and climbing outside off, left alone
they are running away to nowhere, Agarwal goes through with another punchy drive in the air, mid off is there, and had he hit, DK would have been out, he had wandered that far out
now he moves across the stumps, and works this off the pad and wide of fine leg
that is as clean a hit as any, Agarwal has made some room outside leg stump, and blitzed this length delivery over mid off with a straight, high followthrough
walks out, but Vinay moves it in to the pad, and DK cannot get bat on it
too short, too wide, he intentionally flays it in the air and comfortably clears cover

madness out there, Agarwal turns it to midwicket, he wants the single for about a few steps, then he doesn't, DK wants it some more, then he hesitates, decides to go for it, Agarwal has no choice, the captain has made it for him, the throw is way off target at the keeper's end, the man backing up follows up with a worse one at the bowler's end, and it runs all the way to the straight boundary
width outside off, it is guided to third man's right, Narine scrambles to stop it
short of a length into the pad and with one leg in the air, he tucks it to fine leg
lunges forward and has a heave but is beaten by this pitched up ball
very tight single, short ball dropped in front of cover, Agarwal was gone in case of a direct hit
connects alright this time, slightly fuller from Morne, DK comes forward and lifts it over covers
nothing shot, tries to belatedly guide it towards point, beaten by the pace and bounce
Morne finds the radar now, hits his favoured back of a length, and it rears up at DK, fortunate not to edge it
far, far down the leg side from Morne first up, fine effort from the keeper to get some glove on it
good one, this one goes away after drawing DK into a forward push, beaten by some margin

trouble for Vijay, there is a direct hit, superb work from Pandey at backward point, Vijay had walked too far down the pitch after getting hit on the thigh pad with an incoming ball, Pandey swooped on the ball and found Vijay well short
once again into leg stump, and he is fortunate to be taken only for one to short fine as Agarwal cannot get enough on it
length in to the pad now, and Agarwal steps down the track and turn it neatly through midwicket
shot, gets on his toes and punches this back of a length ball in the air just past point
walks out first ball, Vinay nips it in from short of a length, it hits the pad high and rolls to the off side
